method: Static includes from committed blobs; all preprocessor branches included; resolves sibling, lib-relative, then unique lib basename. Not a compiler/link dependency closure. No runtime dependency inferred solely from an include.

adat.branch: historical Eloy-based compatibility branch, not canonical ADAT

xpath_reader.proposed_action: extract/pin standalone parser and compatibility containers; use QDP reader implementation in QDP adapter, never serial reader behind QDP API

filedb.proposed_action: separate pinned external dependency for legacy storage support; preserve database/key encoding; no full ADAT dependency

superbblas.proposed_action: optional storage and evaluator features with separate serial/MPI builds

libxml2.proposed_action: serial parser backend and transitive QDP XML dependency; no version claim from static inventory

qdp_qmp.proposed_action: QDP adapter only; import installed QDP build configuration; discover QMP communication backend rather than assume MPI

limitations: Conditional includes counted without evaluating feature macros.
Header/source implementation candidates are not recursively compiled or link-verified.
External XML/FILEDB includes are grouped and pinned but their complete transitive build closure is not enumerated.
No source files extracted or modified; no new runtime tests executed.
GMP, compiler/OpenMP/BLAS and other transitive link requirements need a later compiler/link dependency audit; they are not assumed mandatory for core.
